author: nincreativestudio
title: NIN Creative Studio is Hiring Illustrators
content: 🎨 NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. 📄 Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ ✨ Why join NIN? ✅ Work across diverse projects and visual styles ✅ Grow your skills alongside our Creative & Art Team ✅ A young, creative, and professional working environment ✅ Flexible Freelance / Part-time / Full-time opportunities ✅ Flexible working hours with Work From Home options 📩 Ready to create with us? Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name] Join us now!

author: theboxplymouth
title: Artist Commission Opportunity - Tides & Tales
content: OPPORTUNITY CALLOUT: ARTIST COMMISSION 🌊🎙️📦 @take_a_part_uk are looking for an artist-producer (or collective) to lead 'Tides & Tales', a multidisciplinary arts and heritage project for the East End community of Plymouth... Key Info: 💰 Total Commission: £16,000 (£12,000 artist fee @ £300/day for 40 days + £4,000 materials/production) 📍 Location: East End of Plymouth 📅 Delivery Window: November 2026 – March 2027 ⏳ EOI Deadline: Friday 23 October 2026 Requirements: 5+ years of socially engaged, collaborative practice High-quality audio/podcast production skills Experience in 3D design, fabrication, or curation for the mobile exhibition cabinet How to apply: Send your CV, a 2-page outline proposal, and work samples to kim@takeapart.org.uk by 23 October.
